outlets.name: MERIAN Reisemagazin (merian.de)
outlets.credible: One of Germany's premier travel magazines; editorial city guides incl. 'Aachens beste Restaurants' and 'Die 13 besten Cafés in Aachen'. German-language editorial curation, not a user-rating aggregator.

outlets.name: Falstaff
outlets.credible: Leading German-language food, wine and restaurant guide with a 100-point rated Restaurant & Inn Guide; its Aachen listing ranks the city's best restaurants and bars. Editorial/critical authority.

outlets.name: stadtleben.de
outlets.credible: Established German city/what's-on portal with editorial curated 'Tipps' guides per city (Aachen breakfast/brunch, coffee, burger). Editorial selection, not a user-review aggregator; used as a corroborating local source.

outlets.name: StädteRegion Aachen — Tourenportal (tourenportal.staedteregion-aachen.de)
outlets.credible: Official tourism/leisure portal of the StädteRegion Aachen; editorial gastronomy listings for the city and its region. German-language official source.

outlets.name: STILPUNKTE
outlets.credible: German regional lifestyle/gastronomy magazine (Rheinland) with editorial venue features incl. Aachen. Corroborating editorial, not a rating aggregator.

outlets.name: kulturserver NRW
outlets.credible: Publicly supported cultural network/database for North Rhine-Westphalia documenting cultural institutions and live venues (e.g. Domkeller as a music venue). Institutional German-language record, paired with an editorial source.
